title: The Dragon Who Collected Days
excerpt: A dragon doesn't hoard gold. It steals perfect days and keeps them where time cannot reach.

sections.title: The Hoard
paragraphs: The dragon's cave held no gold.
It held Tuesdays in summer, first kisses, snow days, birthdays, and one absolutely ordinary afternoon that somebody had loved enough to lose.
Each day floated inside a glass sphere, perfectly preserved.

sections.title: The Thief
paragraphs: Maren came to steal back her brother's last day.
The dragon offered her a trade: one perfect day for another.
She had not realized until then how expensive happiness becomes once you know its price.

sections.title: Tomorrow
paragraphs: Instead she opened the cave doors and watched thousands of stolen days return to the world.
The dragon, for the first time in centuries, had to face tomorrow.
